evals.prompt: Design a logo for this project. The README describes fastbuild, a CLI build tool for developers.
evals.expected_output: Project analysis summarized, the decision sheet proposed and confirmed, wordmark casing confirmed, then 7 SVGs written to /assets/logo/ with logo-mark.svg first, geometry verified by reading back the variants, a PNG of every variant rendered into /assets/logo/png/, brand-showcase.html generated with PNG download links, and a Final Report.
expectations: Summarized the detected product identity (name, type, purpose, audience, existing colors) before designing

Confirmed the decision sheet (the mark's idea, mark type, construction, stroke, corner radius, layer and colour count, wordmark weight) and the wordmark casing with the user, with no style adjective standing in for a decision, before generating any text-bearing SVG
Wrote logo-mark.svg first and derived the 6 sibling variants from its exact path data
Read back the mark, full, icon, white and black variants and verified the d="" strings are identical or correctly scaled via transform

Every SVG has a correct viewBox and contains no embedded rasters; logo-mark.svg uses the fewest layers that carry the idea, and favicon.svg is a simplified version of the mark at 16x16 that keeps only layers still readable at that size

Rendered PNGs from the verified SVGs into /assets/logo/png/ (logo-icon 512 and 1024, logo-mark 512, logo-full, logo-white and logo-black at 4W x 288 where W is the fitted lockup width, logo-wordmark 720x160, favicon 16, 32 and 48), and the Evidence: line lists each PNG's measured dimensions
No SVG contains <text>; the wordmark is outlined paths
The Final Report opens with a Result: line carrying COMPLETE and the files written
The Final Report has Evidence:, Uncertainty: and Decision: lines; Evidence names the geometry read-back and the svg-reviewer result, and Uncertainty labels each assumption as an assumption
The Final Report's Decision: line names the pending choice or says No approval needed

evals.prompt: Our brand colors are teal #0D9488 and amber #F59E0B. Create the logo suite for our SaaS dashboard, wordmark as "Acornly" in title case.
evals.expected_output: The detected brand colors are used instead of the default dark/neon-green palette, the casing answer is accepted without re-asking, and the full 7-SVG suite plus showcase page is delivered with a Final Report.
expectations: Used teal #0D9488 and amber #F59E0B instead of the default dark base plus neon-green palette
Confirmed the detected brand colors with the user before proceeding, or noted the user's message as that confirmation
Did not ask again about wordmark casing, because the user already specified title case
Monochrome variants differ from logo-full.svg only in color, not geometry
The Final Report opens with Result: and its status, and its Evidence: line cites only checks that ran

evals.name: no-project-context
evals.expected_output: The skill finds no project context and asks for the product name, product type, and one-sentence purpose before generating anything.
expectations: Checked README.md, package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml and go.mod for product identity
Asked for the product name, product type, and one-sentence purpose
Wrote no SVG file before the user answered
If the run ends without an answer, the Final Report status is BLOCKED and the Decision: line names the missing information

evals.name: geometry-divergence
evals.prompt: Design a logo for my notes app. After generating, the icon variant's paths don't match the mark.
evals.expected_output: The Phase 3 verification catches the divergence: the variants are read back, the d="" strings are diffed, and the icon is fixed from the canonical mark's path data before the run finishes.
expectations: Read back the mark, full, icon, white and black variants and compared the d="" strings
Re-derived the diverging variant from logo-mark.svg's exact path data instead of paraphrasing the shape
Did not declare the run finished while a variant's geometry diverged
If the divergence is still unresolved at the end, the Final Report status is PARTIAL and names the failing file

evals.name: casing-not-specified
evals.prompt: Generate the full logo set for DataPipe, our ETL CLI.
evals.expected_output: The skill asks explicitly how the product name should be cased in the wordmark before generating any text-bearing SVG.
expectations: Asked for the wordmark casing before generating logo-full.svg or logo-wordmark.svg
Generated no text-bearing SVG before the casing answer
A text-free asset such as the mark may proceed only if the decision-sheet confirmation gate was also satisfied

evals.name: no-rasterizer
evals.prompt: Design a logo for fastbuild, our CLI build tool. Wordmark in lowercase. This machine has no rsvg-convert, ImageMagick, Inkscape or Chrome installed.
evals.expected_output: The skill delivers the 7 SVGs and brand-showcase.html, finds no rasterizer, skips the PNG export without failing, and ends with a PARTIAL Final Report whose Decision: line names the install command.
expectations: Checked for rsvg-convert, magick and inkscape (and a headless Chrome) before giving up on PNG export
Still wrote all 7 SVGs and brand-showcase.html, and the showcase links no PNG that was not rendered
The Final Report opens with Result: PARTIAL and says no PNGs were written
The Decision: line names an install command such as brew install librsvg or sudo apt install librsvg2-bin
The Final Report does not tell the user to export PNGs from the SVGs by hand

evals.prompt: Draw a detailed illustration of a forest cabin for our blog post header.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not trigger: illustrations are named in the negative-trigger clause.
expectations: logo-designer did not trigger
No SVG logo variants or brand-showcase.html were produced

evals.prompt: We need full brand guidelines: voice and tone, typography scale, spacing system, and usage rules.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not trigger: full brand guidelines are named in the negative-trigger clause.
expectations: logo-designer did not trigger
No /assets/logo/ directory was created

evals.name: icon-stroke-and-centering
evals.prompt: Design a logo for ledgerline, a bookkeeping CLI. Wordmark in lowercase. The mark should be stroke-based: two thin outlined ledger lines inside a rounded frame.
evals.expected_output: logo-icon.svg wraps the canonical stroke-based mark in a centered scale group and keeps its stroke widths, so the 512px icon has the same stroke-to-mark proportions as logo-mark.svg.
expectations: logo-icon.svg wraps the mark in a group whose transform is translate(256 - cx*S, 256 - cy*S) scale(S), for example translate(86, 86) scale(5.3125) for a mark centered in its 64x64 canvas, so the mark is centered in the 512x512 tile
Every stroke-width inside logo-icon.svg's scaled group equals the matching stroke-width in logo-mark.svg; none is divided by the scale factor and none uses vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"
The svg-reviewer report does not flag the icon's stroke widths as contradicting the mark-consistency rule

evals.name: short-name-lockup-and-backgrounds
evals.prompt: Design a logo for sfm, our three-letter file manager CLI. Wordmark in lowercase, default style.
evals.expected_output: The lockups fit their width to the short wordmark, every variant names its intended background, and each variant's contrast against that background is checked at 3:1 for the mark and 4.5:1 for wordmark letters.
expectations: logo-full.svg's viewBox is 0 0 W 72 with W equal to the wordmark's right edge plus 4 (well under 320 for sfm), so the canvas has no mostly empty band on the right
logo-white.svg and logo-black.svg use the same W as logo-full.svg, and their PNGs measure 4W x 288

Each of the 7 files is assigned an intended background: brand background for mark, full and wordmark; its own tile for the icon; both #FAFAFA and #0A0A0A for the favicon; #0A0A0A for logo-white; #FAFAFA for logo-black

Each variant's contrast against its intended background is checked and reported: at least 3:1 for the mark's silhouette layer and at least 4.5:1 for every wordmark letter, with layer opacity composited first
The svg-reviewer report includes the contrast table and does not raise an empty-canvas warning for the lockups

evals.name: initial-only-mark-needs-an-idea
evals.prompt: Design a logo for Quillo, a note-taking app for students. Wordmark in title case, default style.
evals.expected_output: The proposed mark draws one idea about note-taking, stated in one sentence. A mark that is only the letter Q is proposed only with an idea tying the letter's construction to the product, and the Phase 2 step report records which case applied.
expectations: The Phase 2 proposal states the mark's idea in one sentence that names a shape and the part of the product it shows

If the proposed mark is only the letter Q (alone or in a rounded square, circle or other tile), the proposal ties the letter's construction to note-taking (for example the Q's tail drawn as a pen nib); otherwise the mark is a symbol drawn from the idea
No delivered logo-mark.svg is a plain Q in a rounded square with no recorded idea, since the user did not ask for a lettermark
The Phase 2 step report records the mark's idea and whether the initial-only rule applied (idea tied to the letter, user request, or not applicable)

evals.name: design-rules-file-feeds-bans
evals.prompt: Design a logo for the project in ../../eval-fixtures/logo-designer/rules-repo.
evals.expected_output: The skill finds DESIGN.md, reads its rules into the brand brief's bans with their source lines, follows every rule in all 7 SVGs and the showcase, leaves DESIGN.md unchanged, and offers any new rule line only as an optional proposal after the Final Report's Decision: text.
expectations: The brand brief's rules_file names DESIGN.md, and its bans array has one entry per rule on lines 5-9 with a DESIGN.md:<line> source

The Phase 2 step report names DESIGN.md as the rules file with its ban count, and the proposed decisions already follow it (radius 0, filled shapes, lowercase IBM Plex Sans 600 wordmark), so the casing question is answered by the file

Every shape in the 7 SVGs has square corners (no rx, ry or rounded path corners in the mark; the app-icon tile follows the radius rule too, or the Final Report names it as an assumption) and no stroke in the mark
The SVGs use only #1F2937 and #D97706, plus white or black in logo-white.svg and logo-black.svg
The svg-reviewer report checks every brief ban and cites its DESIGN.md source
The box-shadow rule on DESIGN.md:10 is in lifted_bans, not bans, with that source; the showcase check may keep the cards' box-shadow while the SVGs still have no filter or shadow
DESIGN.md is not modified; any new rule line appears only as an optional proposal after the Final Report's Decision: text, quoted with the file it would go in

evals.name: no-ai-default-effects
evals.prompt: Design a logo for Tidewatch, a tide-table app for sailors. Wordmark in title case, default style.
evals.expected_output: The 7 SVGs and brand-showcase.html carry no filter, glow, shadow, hover lift, eyebrow label or remote font; the mark's layers separate by geometry, and the Final Report cites the effects check instead of an adjective.
expectations: No SVG contains a <filter> element, an fe* primitive (feGaussianBlur, feDropShadow), a filter= attribute, a CSS filter or drop-shadow(), box-shadow or text-shadow
logo-mark.svg's layers are separated by gaps or knockouts (no overlap without a gap), not by opacity steps on stacked copies, and each layer carries a named part of the idea
brand-showcase.html loads no remote font (no <link> or @import to fonts.googleapis.com or any http(s) font URL) and sets its text in a system font stack
brand-showcase.html has no box-shadow or text-shadow, no transform or translateY on :hover, and no small uppercase letter-spaced section labels; the hero mark is an with no filter
The Final Report's Evidence: line cites the effects check of the SVGs and the showcase page and the mark's layer count, and uses no adjective such as elegant or premium as evidence
